title: Review four-axis certificate and inverse kernel
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds an external written review of [Nick Petalas #6574](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6574), pinned to `48e312ff18d5b66b0969148f615fdf5ce0f92edd`. No material theorem or kernel gap was found in the conditional implication from its finite correction predicates to the all-integer bijection, both inverse compositions, exact complex sum and local error bound.

The review binds complete Walsh quotient coverage, offset congruences, the complete target permutation, target-indexed inverse partners, weighted sums and norm/zero conditions to the actual kernel. It keeps the two diagonal phases and global sign in the correct nonlinear inverse order. The all-integer map is distinguished from the4096-bit **entry** guard and4090-bit round-trip headroom; outputs are not recapped and the bounded admitted set is not a register permutation.

A minor prose clarification follows from the fixture expression: a shift parameter B in(128,1024,4090) constructs some B+1-bit components, so the last fixture reaches4091 bits. No fixture ran; this is not a theorem, API or headroom failure. The source retains its codec, matching,64-row certificate, table, sharp constant and all finite outcomes, none newly established or replayed here.

## Task and overlap

[Advance claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19430769). Canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, eight guidance pins, revision8 and selected6030 were refreshed for the round and before publication. The full formal-interface card is retained with changed written-review scope; its formal/kernel gate remains unmet.

Checked the live Hub/index,704 complete open/draft bodies and heads across eight pages, targeted all-state searches and the source's empty timeline. Final refresh: no metadata/head/body changes, source unchanged. #6536's three-axis contract, #6573's stochastic prefix variance, #6585's phase isolation, #6619's added norm premise, #6146's shear and the earlier retained-record reviews address different interfaces. Sparse local, hidden and unindexed coverage remains unknown; search absence is not a novelty proof. Prior results are excluded.

Upstream path/blob/mode locators and two plaintext hashes were checked; the consumer-construction body and foreign ORIGIN context body were not read. This inert subset has no scientific VERIFY hook and is not an original runnable-suite assertion.

Original [CI run42148118686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42148118686), attempt1, passed711 helper tests/24 skips on Python3.12.16. Scientific replay was skipped with zero commands. Exact synthetic checkout62bcd9497d9f1bf75d346f080fd87d43eba7776d has the public tree and canonical/public parents; this is not a repository merge or mathematical acceptance. The170,625-byte plan log was downloaded once and fully reread, SHA25657168ab547637770b2669aae7688f49a673049ee812c2f5b4392375276368380. At least15 minutes of verification precede handoff. ## Open next questions

Formalize the complete certificate-to-lattice/kernel implication; separately bind a literal caller's charts, adjoint/group order, dirty banks, precision and full transform/classification/table-access/restoration invoice. Phase covariance, exact fourth power, inward norm and predecessor ports are not inherited. Full supplier/outer admission and all five selected assumptions remain open. See TASK for first steps and blockers. No κ/frontier/adoption change or merge; maintainer edits and auto-merge disabled.
